label: Evil, disapproval and internal objection
resolution: The critic's own selected moral evil utterance, expression of disapproval, non-moral suffering report and report of a target-internal logical conflict are distinct roles. Strict truthlessness blocks the own-true-premise use only when all four recorded semantic/classification bridges hold. An affective account by itself does not entail truthlessness. The internal challenge uses target Rowe standards, whose actual gratuitous-suffering and permission commitments remain separate. Catholic privation of due good, voluntary culpa, suffering, stance-independent wrongness and an attitude are not silently identified. RemainingUse is the exact negation of all three named diagnostic conditions. NamedUseCoverage must be supplied or proved separately; retaining Other gives a proved coverage theorem with explicit excluded middle, without exhaustiveness of all philosophical schools. The explicit models establish these formal boundaries, not that any actual thinker endorses the configurations.
